// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/RegExp/proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var o = Reflect.construct(RegExp, [], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.RegExp.prototype);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/RegExp/prototype/Symbol.split/splitter-proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
other.shared = null;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){shared = this; return /./;})");
C.prototype = null;

var r = /./;
r.constructor = function() {};
r.constructor[Symbol.species] = C;

r[Symbol.split]();

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(other.shared), other.Object.prototype);
})();

console.log("DS19 regexp complete");
